samples.label: 02. Filed (incoming), determined and pending cases and matters at Land and environment courts (more detailed division) by Land and Environment Court, Land and environment category, Variable and Year
note: The table illustrates the number of cases and matters at the five Land and Environment Courts. The cases and matters are divided in separate categories. Pending cases and matters are ongoing (open) cases or matters at a specific date.

This tables´s data for the year 2018-2024 were extracted at a later date than other tables concerning land and environment cases and matters, therefore there is a minor discrepance compared to other tables.
Environmental electricity cases only exist at the Land and Environment Court at Nacka District Court.

On May 2, 2011, Land and environment courts were established at five of the country's district courts. Previously, there were special property courts and environment courts at certain district courts.
Cases and matters at the Land and environment courts are included in other tables regarding district courts.
